title: Hershey’s Cocoa-Box Chocolate Cake
description: Two layers of dark cocoa cake filled and covered with the classic chocolate frosting.
imageAlt: Slice of two-layer chocolate cake with swirled chocolate frosting

items: ¾ cup Hershey’s unsweetened cocoa powder
⅔ cup Hershey’s unsweetened cocoa powder
⅓ cup milk, plus more if needed

steps.title: Prepare the pans
steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Grease and flour two 9-inch round cake pans.

steps.title: Mix the batter
steps.text: Whisk the sugar, flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt together. Add the eggs, milk, oil, and vanilla and beat on medium speed for 2 minutes. Carefully stir in the boiling water. The batter will be thin.

steps.title: Bake and cool
steps.text: Divide the batter evenly between the pans. Bake for 30–35 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool in the pans for 10 minutes, then turn the layers onto racks and let them cool completely.

steps.title: Make the frosting
steps.text: Melt the butter and whisk in the cocoa. Beat in the powdered sugar and milk in alternating additions, then beat in the vanilla. Add a splash more milk if the frosting is too stiff to spread.

steps.title: Frost the layers
steps.text: Set one cooled layer on a plate and spread frosting across the top. Add the second layer, then cover the top and sides with the remaining frosting.

source.name: Hershey’s Perfectly Chocolate Cake and Frosting
